main.description: Public commitment to a synthetic FAA 8130-3 Authorized Release Certificate. Contains only identifiers needed for discovery plus a Merkle root over the full form; the form itself never appears here. SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA — not an airworthiness record.

commitment.description: Merkle root over the canonical 15-field set, schema version fieldSetVersion.

fieldSetVersion.description: Version of the committed field order and normalization rules. Absent means 1. Changing field order or normalization requires a new version, never an edit.

issuerDid.description: DID of the issuing organization. Must match the repo this record lives in.

prev.description: Previous shop-visit release for this serial, as a strong reference so the predecessor can be both located and pinned. Absent means birth.

subject.description: Generic asset reference (partNumber:serialNumber for now). Kept generic so aircraft and logbook extensions need no schema change.

signerCert.description: Certificate ID of the authorized individual. Deliberately a string, not a DID reference, in this demonstration.

completedAt.description: Claimed completion time. Attacker-controlled; compare against an observer's independently recorded time.
